cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll name the coworker who reported your lateness if you name whoever reported mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then I'll trade departments. Names cost names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Marketing. And I'll arrange coffee with mine. Same access, same price.

mechanism: A sets the authorized price and granularity of information, then matches increased access only with equal access.
confusable: Unlike freely swapping gossip, A judges each offer and limits the return to the same kind of value.
comparison: Department names and source introductions differ from siblings pricing confessions by punishment.
seedUse: The seed already declares names cost names and matches introductions, so S01 governs the trade terms concretely.
